technical_and_design_decisions: Leveraged Spring XD stream processing architecture and standard module conventions for generator source and perf-meter sink implementations.
Implemented custom module upload REST API using standard Spring MVC multipart upload controller persisting uber-jars to Spring XD module repository.
Generator source module designed using multi-threaded payload generation (ExecutorService) generating byte arrays of defined size.
Perf-meter sink utilizes thread-safe counters (AtomicLong) and nanosecond-precision timing to calculate message rate metrics without blocking processing threads.
Kafka spike focused on low-level Kafka Simple Consumer API for explicit partition management and manual offset tracking.
assumptions: Development environment includes Java 17+, Maven/Gradle, and access to local/test Spring XD container infrastructure.
Target HDFS/HAWQ/GPDB instances or functional test mocks are available for verifying mass data ingestion.
Kafka broker instance is available locally and within the CI pipeline for integration test execution.

activities.activity_description: Design and build data ingestion module capabilities for transferring bulk data from relational databases into target endpoints (HDFS, HAWQ, GPDB).
Investigate Kafka simple consumer API for deterministic offset management and partition assignment; document approach, findings, and recommendations.

activities.activity_name: Custom Module Uber-Jar REST API Endpoint
activities.activity_description: Implement REST API endpoint enabling deployment and installation of custom module uber-jars into the Spring XD cluster repository.
Develop and document a reference GitHub sample application demonstrating Spring XD cluster provisioning with Kafka as message bus and source.
Implement the 'generator' source module supporting configurable parameters (numMsgs, msgSize, numThreads) to produce synthetic test payloads.
Implement the 'perf-meter' sink module to capture throughput metrics and emit timestamped count and rate logs at specified intervals.
Configure and execute 'generator | perf-meter' stream in a single-node container, ingesting 1M messages (1000 bytes) and validating metric output.

activities.activity_name: Kafka Source & Sink Automated CI Test Suite
activities.activity_description: Develop unit and integration test coverage for Kafka source and sink modules to ensure continuous integration automated testing.
